title: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 2 (Commissioning)
(1) Honorary Mayors and heads of Gun shall be commissioned for the Five Northern Provinces and unrecovered Si and Gun under Article 2 of the Special Measures Act on the Five Northern Provinces, Etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Five Northern Provinces, etc.") on the basis of the Si and Gun administrative units existing as at August 15, 1945; they shall hold honorary positions symbolically representing the relevant Si or Gun. <Amended on August 19, 2015.>
(2) Honorary Mayors and heads of Gun shall be commissioned by the President of the Republic of Korea through the Prime Minister, upon nomination by the Minister of the Interior and Safety based on recommendations by the Governors of the Five Northern Provinces, from among persons originating from or having connections with the relevant Si or Gun of the Five Northern Provinces, etc. who possess learning and good reputation and are dedicated to reunification: Provided, That candidates for honorary Mayor or head of Gun of unrecovered Si and Gun shall be recommended by the Chairperson of the Committee for the Five Northern Provinces under Article 7 of the Act and Article 4 of the Regulations on the Committee for the Five Northern Provinces (hereinafter referred to as the "Chairperson"), after hearing the opinions of the Governor of Gyeonggi-do and the Governor of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; August 19, 2015; July 26, 2017; and June 4, 2024.>
(3) Where the position of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun becomes vacant, the Governor (meaning the Chairperson in the case of unrecovered Si or Gun; hereinafter the same shall apply) shall recommend a successor to the Minister of the Interior and Safety without delay: Provided, That the Governor may refrain from recommending a successor where less than six months remain in the predecessor's term. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; August 19, 2015; and July 26, 2017.>
